instruction: Design a system that combines a 2-to-1 multiplexer with an XOR gate. The 2-to-1 mux should choose between two input signals, a and b, based on a select input. If sel_b1 is true, the output should be b. If sel_b2 is true, the output should be a. Otherwise, the output of the XOR gate should be the output of the module. The XOR gate should be implemented using a behavioral always block and a structural design, with two input ports and one output port. You are not allowed to use any built-in XOR gates in your design.
